newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: New Star Trading rises on takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: New Star Trading rises on takeover bid.

text.p: Shares in New Star Trading gained 7.48 percent in early morning trading on Thursday as Seoul-based Savoy Hotel re-offered to buy an additional 30.81 percent stake in the garment maker through a public tender, brokers said.

New Star Trading gained 4,500 won to 64,700 at 0100 GMT, but fell back later to trade at 63,000 won at 0140 GMT. The company's shares closed at 60,200 won on Wednesday. Savoy Hotel offered to buy 148,592 common shares of the garment maker at 65,500 won per share after receiving tenders June 30-July 19 through Ssangyong Securities.
If completed, Savoy with its affiliate and owner family members would be the largest shareholder with a 51.51 percent stake in New Star Trading.
Brokers said New Star Trading shares would remain solid as long as talk of a takeover continued.
